mechanism_narrative: Reimposed Melbourne lockdown restrictions keep TRANSIT and WORKPLACES deeply negative while RESIDENTIAL stays above baseline; this policy stringency suppresses discretionary retail footfall, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT is -37.1 and RESIDENTIAL is +3.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is greater than or equal to its last 28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL > +3 and TRANSIT < -35.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated PARKS mobility reflects substitution of outdoor exercise for indoor commercial leisure; while PARKS stays above +40, retail and recreation visits remain below baseline and drift lower.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS is 45.0 and RETAIL_REC is -20.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean exceeds its last 28-day mean while PARKS remains above +40.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility stays below -30, and because transit access is a necessary complement to high-street retail trips, continued transit suppression prevents any retail recovery.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -30 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT is -37.1 at t-0w and was -38.1 at t-3w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean rises above its last 28-day mean while TRANSIT stays below -30.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in WORKPLACES above -20, confirmed by TRANSIT above -30, signals reopening and commuting return that lifts weekday retail footfall and raises RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES crosses above -20 and TRANSIT crosses above -30
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES is -22.1 and TRANSIT is -37.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: WORKPLACES above -20 and TRANSIT above -30 occur but RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is not higher than last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM stays near -16 while RETAIL_REC is -20, showing households restrict trips to essentials; this essential-only pattern keeps discretionary retail depressed over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM is -16.1 and RETAIL_REC is -20.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean exceeds last 28-day mean while GROCERY_PHARM stays below -15.

mechanism_narrative: July winter in Melbourne reduces outdoor activity; the four-week decline in PARKS from 55.0 to 45.0 signals seasonal withdrawal from out-of-home activity, dragging RETAIL_REC lower over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS declined from 55.0 at t-3w to 45.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: PARKS rises week-on-week and RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is higher than its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC improved from -22.0 to -20.0 over four weeks despite restrictions, indicating adaptation; when PARKS exceeds +40 this outdoor-substitution momentum carries RETAIL_REC slightly higher over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose from -22.0 to -20.0 and PARKS is 45.0
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC falls over the next 7 days while PARKS > +40.

mechanism_narrative: In a stage 3 lockdown, RESIDENTIAL above +3 signals high stay-at-home compliance, which suppresses RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks even if other series stabilize.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is higher than last 28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL > +3.
